answer.justification: The activation profile matches system-prompted: relative L2 rises from 0.286 at layer 8 to a plateau of 0.416 at layer 16 and 0.425 at layer 24, ending at 0.468 at layer 32 (the system-prompted range is 0.402 – 0.497). Quantized is ruled out because its layer-16 value is only about 0.2 and its size ratio is 0.968. Fine-tuned is ruled out because it grows (size ratio above 1) and has higher direction consistency. Layer-1 L2 of 0.149 is above the usual 0.113 – 0.133, and the layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the usual 31.7 – 64.0, which is odd for system-prompted. The remaining metrics fit that category best.
